claims.text: MEASURED COST (2026-07-29, both indexes built end-to-end and diffed): ... cost is bounded on every real repo available, and cost is NOT the reason for the gate.

observations.what: The module docstring contains extensive design rationale and historical measurement data, but the actual implementation is in later chunks.
Several imports (e.g., CloneMemo, FileAnalysis) are imported but unused in this chunk; they are presumably used in later chunks.
The _collect function has side effect of walking the filesystem (os.walk) but is marked with effects ['filesystem_write'] which is inaccurate; it only reads the filesystem, does not write.
The docstring claims 'OPT-IN, absent unless documents=True (or DAEDALUS_INDEX_DOCUMENTS=1)' but no code in this chunk implements such a flag or reads that environment variable.
The docstring claims 'OPT-IN, absent unless types=True (or DAEDALUS_INDEX_TYPES=1)' but no code in this chunk implements such a flag or reads that environment variable.
